name: Fürged (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of blue and yellow at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Fürged: a blue and red shield with yellow stars, a patriarchal cross and white feathers.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
